Class ModelTests

java.lang.Object
kanishTests.ModelTests
public final class ModelTests extends Object
Semi-automated GUI-model contracts, using an explicitly nonpersistent full-TP2 fixture. Each documented test names the local requirement, exercise and pass interpretation.
